question: Should the canonical Signal quote implementation come from this broad branch with a public `replyToId: null` SDK contract, or from the maintainer native Signal quote path with a narrower/private suppression seam?
rationale: The remaining blocker is partly API and product direction: automation can identify the SDK-contract conflict and overlapping branches, but cannot choose the long-term plugin contract or canonical Signal quote branch.

options.title: Use the maintainer native quote path
options.body: Prefer https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95718 as the canonical direction, then port only any unique tests or narrow fixes from this branch.

options.title: Repair this branch before merge
options.body: Keep this PR as the landing branch only after it fixes BodyForAgent quote context, removes or explicitly documents the public null SDK contract, and adds live Signal proof.

options.title: Approve the public null contract
options.body: Maintainers may intentionally bless `replyToId: null` as plugin API, but that should come with docs, API/baseline tests, and compatibility messaging.

recommendation.title: Use the maintainer native quote path
recommendation.body: Prefer https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95718 as the canonical direction, then port only any unique tests or narrow fixes from this branch.

likelyOwner.reason: The overlapping maintainer-labeled native Signal quote PR has the clearest current owner signal for the canonical Signal quote/API direction.
